main_text.p: gelorum exercitus, Angelorumque diversa castra, loquentes multa de מנחנ, quod turmatim concurrant Angeli ad militiam, de מחנה אלהים Castris divinis, quod castrametentur Angeli circa timentes Dominum, Psalmo 34. v. 8. probantes ex Genes. cap. 32. v. 2. Jacobum Patriarcham appellasse locum Machanaim, quod bina ibidem Angelorum comitantium castra conspexisset, castra Angelorum excubantium pro salute terrae Israelis seu Canaan, & castra Angelorum defendentium provincias extra terram Israelis, de quibus sic Author Zennorennae, qui commentarius est Hebraeo Germanicus in Legem, Genes. cap. 32. fol. 41. Es kamen die Malachim von Erez Israel, zu beleiten ihn (Jacob) in Erez Israel, Und er nennete den Ort Machanaim (zwei Heer:) dieweil er hat gesehen zwo Schaaren von Malachim: Die Malachim von außerhalb Landes / die ihn haben beleitet bis allher / und auch die Malachim von Erez Israel; Sic castrorum Angelicorum meminit quoque Rabbi Jedaia Happenini, quando in Bakkascha, seu meditatione sua, sectione secunda refert: Scintilla luminis tui ab antiquitate scaturigo diffluit, a splendore tuo effunditur, inde separantur castra intelligentiarum admirabilium, quae sunt subtiliantia purissima, intelligentes ex se ipsis; Sic Rabbi Dialman

page.notes: Hebrew words in the first lines and the Hebrew phrase "מחנה אלהים" are read with doubt; the Hebrew forms may be misprinted. Black letter used for German words. The catchword "Dlalman" appears to be a printing error for "Dialman"; it is left as printed. The Greek or Hebrew reference marks and the section letters are not clearly legible in the scan.
